review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines `peripheralAut` (a subgroup of `ContinuousAut F`), `conj` (inner automorphisms as a hom into that subgroup), and `exponent` (a character). `ContinuousAut` itself is defined in the TauCeti library, not in this file. I found no Mathlib group structure on `G ≃ₜ* G` in `Mathlib/Topology/Algebra`; the only matching instance there is `Inhabited`. I found no Mathlib, Batteries or core concept that these declarations compete with. `conj` is a codomain-restricted version of `ContinuousAut.conj` and is built from it with `codRestrict`, so I count it as a named specialisation. `exponent` is a bespoke character defined with `Classical.choose`. I looked for a Mathlib notion it duplicates and found none. I did not search for a TauCeti-internal duplicate between `peripheralAut` and `peripheralPermAut`, but the rubric only covers duplication of Mathlib concepts.
